The History of al-Tabari: Bahrain then returned [to his homeland] rejoicing.
تاريخ الطبري: وانصرف بهرام مسرورا.

The History of al-Tabari: After this, Bahram sent Mihr Narsi, son of Burazah, on an expedition against the Roman lands, at the head of a force of forty thousand warriors.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم انه اغزى مهر نرسى بن برازة بلاد الروم في أربعين ألف مقاتل،

The History of al-Tabari: He ordered him to make for their supreme ruler {'azlm) and discuss with him the question of the tribute and other things, tasks that only a man of Mihr Narsi's caliber could undertake.
تاريخ الطبري: وأمره أن يقصد عظيمها، ويناظره في أمر الإتاوة وغيرها، مما لم يكن يقوم بمثله إلا مثل مهر نرسي،

The History of al-Tabari: Mihr Narsi then marched off with this army and materiel, and entered Constantinople.
تاريخ الطبري: فتوجه في تلك العدة، ودخل القسطنطينية،

The History of al-Tabari: He played a notable role there, and the supreme ruler of the Romans made a truce with him.
تاريخ الطبري: وقام مقاما مشهورا، وهادنه عظيم الروم،

The History of al-Tabari: He returned homeward having achieved all that Bahram had desired, and the latter heaped honors unceasingly on Mihr Narsi.
تاريخ الطبري: وانصرف بكل الذي أراد بهرام، ولم يزل لمهر نرسي مكرما،

The History of al-Tabari: His name was sometimes rendered in a "lightened" (mukhaffaf) form as just Narsi, and sometimes people would say Mihr Narsih.
تاريخ الطبري: وربما خفف اسمه فقيل نرسي وربما قيل مهر نرسه،

The History of al-Tabari: He was Mihr NarsI, son of Burazah, son of Farrukhzadh, son of Khurahbadh, son of SIsfadh, son of SIsanabruh, son of Kay Ashak, son of Dara, son of Dara, son of Bahman, son of Isfandiyar, son of Bishtasb
تاريخ الطبري: وهو مهر نرسى بن برازه بن فرخزاذ بن خورهباذ بن سيسفاذ ابن سيسنابروه بن كي أشك بن دارا بن دارا بن بهمن بن إسفنديار بن بشتاسب.

The History of al-Tabari: Mihr NarsI was held in high honor by all the kings of Persia because of his fine education and manners, the excellence of his judgment, and the contentedness and tractability of the masses of the people with him.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان مهر نرسي معظما عند جميع ملوك فارس بحسن أدبه، وجودة آرائه، وسكون العامة إليه،

The History of al-Tabari: He had, moreover, several sons, who approached him in worth and who fulfilled various offices for the monarchs that almost reached his own office [in rank and importance].
تاريخ الطبري: وكان له أولاد مع ذلك قد قاربوه في القدر، وعملوا للملوك من الأعمال ما كادوا يلحقون بمرتبته،

The History of al-Tabari: There were three of them who had reached an outstanding position.
تاريخ الطبري: وإن منهم ثلاثة قد كانوا برزوا:

The History of al-Tabari: One was Zurwandadh, whom Mihr NarsI had intended for religion and the religious law.
تاريخ الطبري: احدهم زروانداذ، كان مهر نرسي قصد به للدين والفقه،

The History of al-Tabari: In this sphere he attained such a leading position that Bahram Jur appointed him Chief Herbadh (Hirbadhan Hirbadh), a rank near to that of Chief Mobadh.
تاريخ الطبري: فأدرك من ذلك أمرا عظيما، حتى صيره بهرام جور هربذان هربذ، مرتبة شبيهة بمرتبة موبذان موبذ

The History of al-Tabari: The second was called Majusnas, who remained in charge of the department of the land tax all through the reign of Bahram Jur, the name of his rank in Persian being Wastra’i’ushan Salar
تاريخ الطبري: وكان يقال للآخر: ما جشنس، ولم يزل متوليا ديوان الخراج أيام بهرام جور وكان اسم مرتبته بالفارسية راستراي وشانسلان

The History of al-Tabari: The third was called Kard[ar], supreme commander of the army, the name of his rank in Persian being Rathashtaran Salar;  this is a rank higher than that of al-Isbahbadh and is near to that of al-Arjabadh.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان الثالث اسمه كارد صاحب الجيش الأعظم، واسم مرتبته بالفارسية اسطران سلار، وهذه مرتبة فوق مرتبة الإصبهبذ تقارب مرتبة الأرجبذ،

The History of al-Tabari: Mihr Narsl's own title of rank was in Persian Buzurjfarmadhar, which means in Arabic "supreme vizier" [wazlr al-vmzaia') or "supreme executive" (za’Is al-ru’asd’).
تاريخ الطبري: وكان اسم مهر نرسي بمرتبته بالفارسية بزرجفرماندار، وتفسيره بالعربية وزير الوزراء أو رئيس الرؤساء

The History of al-Tabari: He is said to have come from a town (qaryah) called Abruwan in the rural district of Dasht-i Barm in the province of Ardashir Khurrah.
تاريخ الطبري: وقيل إنه كان من قرية يقال لها ابروان من رستاق دشتبارين من كورة أردشير خرة،

The History of al-Tabari: He had lofty buildings erected there and at Jirih, in the province of Sabur, because of the contiguity of that and Dasht-i Barm, and he constructed there for himself a fire temple, which is said to be still in existence today, with its fire still burning to this present mo-ment.
تاريخ الطبري: فابتنى فيه وفي جره من كورة سابور لاتصال ذلك ودشتبارين أبنية رفيعة، واتخذ فيها بيت نار- هو باق فيما ذكر إلى اليوم وناره توقد إلى هذه الغاية-

The History of al-Tabari: It is called Mihr Narsiyan.
تاريخ الطبري: يقال لها مهر نرسيان،

The History of al-Tabari: In the vicinity of Abruwan he founded four villages, with a fire temple in each one.
تاريخ الطبري: واتخذ بالقرب من ابروان أربع قرى، وجعل في كل واحدة منها بيت نار،

The History of al-Tabari: He set up one of these for himself and called it Faraz-mara-awar-khudaya, meaning [in Arabic] "come to me, O my lord," with the aim of showing great veneration for the fire.
تاريخ الطبري: فجعل واحدا منها لنفسه، وسماه فراز مرا آور خذايان، وتفسير ذلك: اقبلي إلي سيدتي، على وجه التعظيم للنار،

The History of al-Tabari: The second one was meant for Zarawandadh, and he called it Zarawandadhan.
تاريخ الطبري: وجعل الآخر لزراونداذ، وسماه زراوندادان،

The History of al-Tabari: The third was for Kard[ar], and he called it Kardadhan; and the last was for Ma- jushnas, and he called it Majushnasfan.
تاريخ الطبري: والآخر لكارد وسماه كارداذان، والآخر لماجشنس، وسماه ماجشنسفان،

The History of al-Tabari: He also laid out three gardens in this region: in one of them he planted twelve thousand date palms; in another, twelve thousand olive trees; and in [the third] garden, twelve thousand cypress trees.
تاريخ الطبري: واتخذ في هذه الناحية ثلاث باغات، جعل في كل باغ منها اثنتى عشره ألف نخلة، وفي باغ اثني عشر ألف اصل زيتون، وفي باغ اثنتى عشره ألف سروة،

The History of al-Tabari: These villages, with  the gardens and the fire temples, have remained continuously in the hands of his descendants, who are well known till today, and it has been mentioned that all these remain in the best possible condition at the present time.
تاريخ الطبري: ولم تزل هذه القرى والباغات وبيوت النيران في يد قوم من ولده معروفين إلى اليوم، وإن ذلك- فيما ذكر- إلى اليوم باق على أحسن حالاته.

The History of al-Tabari: It has been mentioned that, after he had finished with Khaqan and the King of the Romans, Bahram proceeded to the land of the blacks, in the region of Yemen, and fell upon them, wreaking great slaughter among them and taking large numbers of captives before returning to his kingdom.
تاريخ الطبري: وذكر أن بهرام بعد فراغه من أمر خاقان وأمر ملك الروم، مضى إلى بلاد السودان من ناحية اليمن، فأوقع بهم، فقتل منهم مقتلة عظيمة، وسبى منهم خلقا، ثم انصرف إلى مملكته

The History of al-Tabari: Then followed his death in the manner we have described.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم كان من أمر هلاكه ما قد وصفت.

The History of al-Tabari: There are differing views on the length of his reign.
تاريخ الطبري: واختلفوا في مدة ملكة،

The History of al-Tabari: Some say that it was eighteen years, ten months, and twenty days, others that it was twenty-three years, ten months, and twenty days.
تاريخ الطبري: فقال بعضهم: كان ملكه ثماني عشرة سنة وعشره أشهر وعشرين يوما وقال آخرون كان ملكه ثلاثا وعشرين سنة وعشرة أشهر وعشرين يوما

The History of al-Tabari: [Yazdajird II]
تاريخ الطبري: ذكر ملك يزدجرد بن بهرام جور

The History of al-Tabari: Then there succeeded to the royal power after him Yazdajird, son of Bahram Jtir.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم قام بالملك من بعده يزدجرد بن بهرام جور

The History of al-Tabari: When the crown had been placed on his head, the great men of state and the nobles (ashraf) came into his presense, invoked blessings on his head, and congratulated him on his accession to the royal power.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما عقد التاج على رأسه دخل عليه العظماء والأشراف، فدعوا له وهنئوه بالملك،

The History of al-Tabari: He replied to them in pleasant terms and mentioned his father, his virtues, how he had behaved toward the subjects, and how lengthy his sessions for them (sc., for hearing complaints and receiving petitions) had been.
تاريخ الطبري: فرد عليهم ردا حسنا، وذكر أباه ومناقبه، وما كان منه إلى الرعية، وطول جلوسه كان لها،

The History of al-Tabari: He told them that if they did not experience from him just what they had been used to experience from his father, they should not condemn him, for his periods of withdrawal from public gaze at court were only for some aspect of public good for the kingdom and to trick enemies.
تاريخ الطبري: وأعلمهم أنهم إن فقدوا منه مثل الذي كانوا يعهدونه من أبيه، فلا ينبغي لهم أن يستنكروه، فإن خلواته انما تكون في مصلحه للمملكة وكيد للأعداء،

The History of al-Tabari: [He went on to say] that he had appointed Mihr NarsI, the son of Burazah, his father's aide, as his vizier, that he would behave with them in the best possible manner and would lay down for them the best of ways of conduct, and that he would unceasingly humble his enemies but continuously behave with mildness and benevolence to his subjects and his troops.
تاريخ الطبري: وأنه قد استوزر مهر نرسي بن برازة صاحب أبيه، وإنه سائر فيهم بأحسن السيرة، ومستن لهم أفضل السنن، ولم يزل قامعا لعدوه، رءوفا برعيته وجنوده، محسنا إليهم.

The History of al-Tabari: Yazdajird had two sons, one called Hurmuz, who was ruler over Sijistan, and the other called Fayruz.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان له ابنان: يقال لأحدهما هرمز، وكان ملكا على سجستان، والآخر يقال له فيروز،

The History of al-Tabari: It was Hurmuz (n) who seized the royal power after his father Yazdajird's death.
تاريخ الطبري: فغلب هرمز على الملك من بعد هلاك أبيه يزدجرد،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz  fled from him and reached the land of the Hephthalites [al- Hayafilah).
تاريخ الطبري: فهرب فيروز منه ولحق ببلاد الهياطلة،

The History of al-Tabari: He told their king the story of what had happened between him and his brother and that he had a better right to the throne than Hurmuz.
تاريخ الطبري: وأخبر ملكها بقصته وقصة هرمز أخيه، وإنه أولى بالملك منه،

The History of al-Tabari: He asked the king to provide him with an army with which he could combat Hurmuz and gain control of his father's kingdom, but the king of the Hephthalites refused to re-spond to his request until he received information that Hurmuz really was a tyrannical and unjust king.
تاريخ الطبري: وسأله أن يمده بجيش يقاتل بهم هرمز، ويحتوي على ملك أبيه، فأبى ملك الهياطلة أن يجيبه إلى ما سأل من ذلك، حتى أخبر أن هرمز ملك ظلوم جائر

The History of al-Tabari: He said, "God is not pleased with injustice, and He does not let the works of those committing it prosper; under the rule of an unjust king, a man cannot succeed properly in any enterprise or practice any trade successfully except by injustice and tyranny likewise."
تاريخ الطبري: فقال ملك الهياطلة: إن الجور لا يرضاه الله، ولا يصلح عمل أهله، ولا يستطاع أن ينتصف ويحترف في ملك الملك الجائر إلا بالجور والظلم

The History of al-Tabari: Then, after Fayruz had made over al-Talaqan to him, he provided Fayruz with an army.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمد فيروز بعد أن دفع إليه الطالقان بجيش،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz advanced with it and gave battle to his brother Hurmuz, killing him, scattering his forces, and seizing control of his kingdom.
تاريخ الطبري: فأقبل بهم وقاتل هرمز أخاه فقتله، وشتت جمعه، وغلب على الملك.

The History of al-Tabari: The Romans had been dilatory in forwarding to Yazdajird, the son of Bahrain, the tribute they used to pay to his father.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان الروم التاثوا على يزدجرد بن بهرام في الخراج الذي كانوا يحملونه إلى أبيه،

The History of al-Tabari: Hence Fayruz sent against them Mihr Narsi, the son of Burazah, with an army and materiel such as Bahrain had originally sent against them for that purpose (sc., of exacting tribute), and Mihr Narsi secured the imposition of his master's will for him.
تاريخ الطبري: فوجه إليهم مهر نرسي بن برازة، في مثل العدة التي كان بهرام وجهه إليهم عليها، فبلغ له إرادته

The History of al-Tabari: According to some authorities, Yazdajird's period of royal power was eighteen years and four months, but according to others, seventeen years.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان ملك يزدجرد ثماني عشرة سنة وأربعة أشهر في قول بعضهم. وفي قول آخرين سبع عشره سنه.

The History of al-Tabari: [Fayiuzl]
تاريخ الطبري: ذكر ملك فيروز بن يزدجرد

The History of al-Tabari: Then there succeeded to the royal power Fayruz, son of Yazdajird (II), son of Bahram Jur, after he had killed his brother and three [other] members of his family.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم ملك فيروز بن يزدجرد بن بهرام جور، بعد أن قتل أخاه وثلاثة نفر من اهل بيته.

The History of al-Tabari: There was related to me a report going back to Hisham b. Muhammad [in which] he said: Fayruz prepared for war with the resources of Khurasan and called upon the men of Tukharistan and regions neighboring on it for support, and marched against his brother Hurmuz, son of Yazdajird (n), who was at al-Rayy.
تاريخ الطبري: وحدثت عن هشام بن مُحَمَّد، قَالَ: استعد فيروز من خراسان، واستنجد بأهل طخارستان وما يليها، وسار إلى أخيه هرمز بن يزدجرد، وهو بالري

The History of al-Tabari: Both Fayruz and Hurmuz had a common mother, called Dlnak, who was at al-Mada’in governing that part of the kingdom adjacent to it.
تاريخ الطبري: - وكانت أمهما واحدة، واسمها دينك، وكانت بالمدائن تدبر ما يليها من الملك-

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz captured and im-prisoned his brother.
تاريخ الطبري: فظفر فيروز بأخيه فحبسه،

The History of al-Tabari: He displayed just rule and praiseworthy  conduct, and showed piety.
تاريخ الطبري: وأظهر العدل وحسن السيرة، وكان يتدين،

The History of al-Tabari: During his time, there was a seven- year-long famine, but he arranged things very competently: he divided out the monies in the public treasury, refrained from levying taxation, and governed his people to such good effect that only one person died through want in all those years.
تاريخ الطبري: وقحط الناس في زمانه سبع سنين، فأحسن تدبير ذلك الأمر حتى قسم ما في بيوت الأموال، وكف عن الجباية، وساسهم أحسن السياسة، فلم يهلك في تلك السنين أحد ضياعا إلا رجل واحد.

The History of al-Tabari: He then marched against a people called the Hephthalites, who had taken over Tukharistan.
تاريخ الطبري: وسار إلى قوم كانوا قد غلبوا على طخارستان يقال لهم الهياطلة،

The History of al-Tabari: At the outset of his reign, he had strengthened their power, because they had helped him against his brother (sc., Hurmuzj. They allegedly practiced sodomy, hence Fayruz did not deem it permissible (or: it was not deemed permissible) to leave the land in their hands.
تاريخ الطبري: وقد كان قوادهم في أول ملكة لمعونتهم إياه على أخيه، وكانوا- فيما زعموا- يعملون عمل قوم لوط، فلم يستحل ترك البلاد في أيديهم،

The History of al-Tabari: He attacked the Hephthalites, but they killed him in battle, together with four of his sons and four of his brothers, all of whom bore the title of king.
تاريخ الطبري: فقاتلهم فقتلوه في المعركة، وأربعة بنين له، وأربعة أخوة، كلهم كان يتسمى بالملك،

The History of al-Tabari: The Hephthalites conquered the whole of Khurasan, until there rose up against them a man of Fars, from the people of Shiraz,among whom he was a chief, called Sukhra.
تاريخ الطبري: وغلبوا على عامة خراسان حتى سار إليهم رجل من اهل فارس يقال له سوخرا من أهل شيراز، وكان فيهم عظيما،

The History of al-Tabari: Sukhra went forth with a band of followers, like a volunteer fighter and one seeking a heavenly reward for his action, until he encountered the ruler of the Hephthalites and expelled him from the land of Khurasan.
تاريخ الطبري: فخرج فيمن تبعه شبه المحتسب المتطوع حتى لقي صاحب الهياطلة، فأخرجه من بلاد خراسان،

The History of al-Tabari: The two sides now disengaged and made peace,- all those members of Fayruz's army who had not by then perished and had been made captive—men, women and children—were repatriated. Fayruz had reigned for twenty seven years.
تاريخ الطبري: فافترقا على الصلح، ورد ما لم يضع مما في عسكر فيروز من الإسراء والسبي وملك سبعا وعشرين سنه.

The History of al-Tabari: Another purveyor of historical traditions other than Hisham has stated that Fayruz was a man of limited capability, generally unsuccessful in his undertakings, who brought down evil and misfortune on his subjects, and the greater part of his sayings and the actions he undertook brought down injury and calamity upon both himself and the people of his realm.
تاريخ الطبري: وقال غير هشام من أهل الأخبار: كان فيروز ملكا محدودا محارفا مشئوما على رعيته، وكان جل قوله وفعله فيما هو ضرر وآفة عليه وعلى أهل مملكته

The History of al-Tabari: During his reign, a great famine came over the land for seven years continuously.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن البلاد قحطت في ملكه سبع سنين متوالية،

The History of al-Tabari: Streams, qanats, and springs dried up; trees and reed beds became dessi- cated; the major part of all tillage and thickets of vegetation were reduced to dust in the plains and the mountains of his land alike,bringing about the deaths there of birds and wild beasts; cattle and horses grew so hungry that they could hardly draw any loads; and the water in the Tigris became very sparse.
تاريخ الطبري: فغارت الأنهار والقنى والعيون، وقحلت الأشجار والغياض، وهاجت عامة الزروع والأجام في السهل والجبل من بلاده، وموتت فيها الطير والوحوش، وجاعت الأنعام والدواب، حتى كانت لا تقدر أن تحمل حمولة، وقل ماء دجلة،

The History of al-Tabari: Dearth, hunger, hardship, and various calamities became general for the people of his  land.
تاريخ الطبري: وعم أهل بلاده اللزبات والمجاعة والجهد والشدائد.

The History of al-Tabari: He accordingly wrote to all his subjects, informing them that the land and capitation taxes were suspended, and extraordinary levies (na’ibah) and corvees (sukhrah) were abolished, and that he had given them complete control over their own affairs, commending them to take all possible measures in finding food and sustenance to keep them going.
تاريخ الطبري: فكتب إلى جميع رعيته يعلمهم انه لا خراج عليهم ولا جزية، ولا نائبة ولا سخرة، وأن قد ملكهم أنفسهم، ويأمرهم بالسعي فيما يقوتهم ويقيمهم،

The History of al-Tabari: He wrote further to them that anyone who had a subterranean food store (matmurah), a granary, foodstuffs, or anything that could provide nourishment for the people and enable them to assist each other, should release these supplies, and that no one should appropriate such things exclusively for himself.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم أعاد الكتاب إليهم في اخراج كل من كان له منهم مطموره أو هرى أو طعام أو غيره، مما يقوت الناس، والتأسي فيه، وترك الاستئثار فيه،

The History of al-Tabari: Furthermore, rich and poor, noble and mean, should share equally and aid each other.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن يكون حال أهل الغنى والفقر وأهل الشرف والضعة في التأسي واحدا.

The History of al-Tabari: He also told them that if he received news that a single individual had died of hunger, he would retaliate upon the people of that town, village, or place where the death from starvation had occurred, and inflict exemplary punishment on them.
تاريخ الطبري: وأخبرهم أنه إن بلغه أن إنسيا مات جوعا عاقب أهل المدينة، أو أهل القرية، أو الموضع الذي يموت فيه ذلك الإنسي جوعا، ونكل بهم أشد النكال.

The History of al-Tabari: In this way, Fayruz ordered the affairs of his subjects during that period of death and hunger so adroitly that no one perished of starvation except for one man from the rural district of Ardashir Khurrah, called Dih.
تاريخ الطبري: فساس فيروز رعيته في تلك اللزبة والمجاعة سياسة لم يعطب أحد منهم جوعا، ما خلا رجلا واحدا من رستاق كورة اردشير خرة، يدعى بديه

The History of al-Tabari: The great men of Persia, all the inhabitants of Ardashir Khurrah and Fayruz himself considered that as something terrible.
تاريخ الطبري: فتعظم ذلك عظماء الفرس، وجميع أهل اردشير خرة وفيروز،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz implored his Lord to bestow His mercy on him and his subjects and to send down His rain (or, assistance, ghayth) upon them.
تاريخ الطبري: وإنه ابتهل إلى ربه في نشر رحمته له ولرعيته، وإنزال غيثه عليهم،

The History of al-Tabari: So God aided him by causing it to rain.
تاريخ الطبري: فأغاثه الله،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz's land once more had a profusion of water, just as it had had previously, and the trees were restored to a flourishing state.
تاريخ الطبري: وعادت بلاده في كثرة المياه على ما كانت تكون عليه، وصلحت الأشجار.

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz now gave orders for a town to be built near al-Rayy and called it Ram Fayruz; another town between Jurjan and the Gate ofSul and called it Rushan Fayruz; and a third one in the region of Azerbaijan, which he named Shahram Fayruz.
تاريخ الطبري: وإن فيروز أمر فبنيت بالري مدينة، وسماها رام فيروز، وفيما بين جرجان وباب صول مدينة، وسماها روشن فيروز، وبناحيه اذربيجان مدينة وسماها شهرام فيروز

The History of al-Tabari: When Fayruz's land had revived and his kingly rule there was firmly established, when he had inflicted condign violence on his enemies and subdued them, and when he had completed the building of these three towns, he set off with his army for Khurasan, with the aim of making war on Akhshunwar, king of the Hephthalites.
تاريخ الطبري: ولما حييت بلاد فيروز، واستوثق له الملك، وأثخن في أعدائه وقهرهم، وفرغ من بناء هذه المدن الثلاث، سار بجنوده نحو خراسان مريدا حرب اخشنوار ملك الهياطلة،

The History of al-Tabari: When news of this reached Akhshunwar, he was stricken with terror.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما بلغ اخشنوار خبره اشتد منه رعبه

The History of al-Tabari: It is mentioned that one of Akhshun- war's retainers offered up his life for him and told him, "Cut off my hands and feet and hurl me down in Fayruz's way; but look after my children and family."
تاريخ الطبري: فذكر أن رجلا من أصحاب اخشنوار بذل له نفسه، وقال له: اقطع يدي ورجلي، وألقني على طريق فيروز، وأحسن إلى ولدي وعيالي

The History of al-Tabari: He intended by this, so it has been mentioned, to trick Fayruz.
تاريخ الطبري: - يريد بذلك فيما ذكر الاحتيال لفيروز-

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar did this to the man, and threw him down in Fayruz's way.
تاريخ الطبري: ففعل ذلك اخشنوار بذلك الرجل، وألقاه على طريق فيروز،

The History of al-Tabari: When Fayruz passed by him, he was distressed at the man's state, and asked him what had happened to him. The man informed him that Akhshunwar had done that to him because he had told Akhshunwar that he would be unable to stand up against the Persian troops.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما مر به أنكر حاله وسأله عن أمره، فأخبره أن اخشنوار فعل ذلك به لأنه قَالَ له: لا قوام لك بفيروز وجنود الفرس

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz accordingly felt pity and compassion for him, and ordered him to be carried with him.
تاريخ الطبري: فرق له فيروز ورحمه، وأمر بحمله معه،

The History of al-Tabari: The man told Fayruz, by way of advice, so it is alleged, that he would show him and his followers a short cut, which no one had ever previously used, to get to the king of the Hephthalites.
تاريخ الطبري: فأعلمه على وجه النصح منه له- فيما زعم- أنه يدله وأصحابه على طريق مختصر لم يدخل إلى ملك الهياطلة منه أحد،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz was taken in by this trickery, and he and his troops set off along the route the mutilated man had told him about.
تاريخ الطبري: فاغتر فيروز بذلك منه، وأخذ بالقوم في الطريق الذي ذكره له الأقطع،

The History of al-Tabari: They kept on floundering through one desert after another, and whenever they complained of thirst, the man would tell them that they were near to water and had almost crossed the desert.
تاريخ الطبري: فلم يزل يقطع بهم مفازة بعد مفازة، فكلما شكوا عطشا أعلمهم أنهم قد قربوا من الماء ومن قطع المفازة،

The History of al-Tabari: Finally, when the man had brought them to a place where, he knew, they could neither go forward nor back, he revealed to them what he had done.
تاريخ الطبري: حتى إذا بلغ بهم موضعا علم أنهم لا يقدرون فيه على تقدم ولا تأخر، بين لهم أمره،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz's retainers said to him, "We warned you about this man, O King, but you would not be warned.
تاريخ الطبري: فقال أصحاب فيروز لفيروز: قد كنا حذرناك هذا أيها الملك فلم تحذر،

The History of al-Tabari: Now we can only go forward until we encounter the enemy, whatever the circumstances may be.
تاريخ الطبري: فأما الآن فلا بد من المضي قدما حتى نوافي القوم على الحالات كلها

The History of al-Tabari: " So they pressed ever onward; thirst killed the greater part of them, and Fayruz went on with the survivors against the enemy.
تاريخ الطبري: فمضوا لوجوههم، وقتل العطش أكثرهم، وصار فيروز بمن نجا معه إلى عدوهم،

The History of al-Tabari: When they contemplated the state to which they had been reduced, they appealed to Akhshunwar for a peaceagreement, on the basis that he would allow them freely to return  to their homeland, while Fayruz would promise Akhshunwar, with an oath and an agreement sworn before God, that he would never in the future mount raids against him, covet his territories, or send against him an army to make war on them.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما أشرفوا عليهم على الحال التي هم فيها دعوا اخشنوار إلى الصلح، على أن يخلي سبيلهم، حتى ينصرفوا إلى بلادهم، على أن يجعل فيروز له عهد الله وميثاقه الا يغزوهم ولا يروم أرضهم، ولا يبعث إليهم جندا يقاتلونهم،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz further undertook to establish a boundary between the two kingdoms, which he would not cross.
تاريخ الطبري: ويجعل بين مملكتها حدا لا يجوزه

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar was content with these promises.
تاريخ الطبري: فرضي اخشنوار بذلك

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz wrote for him a document, properly sealed and with his obligations guaranteed by professonal witnesses.
تاريخ الطبري: وكتب له به فيروز كتابا مختوما، وأشهد له على نفسه شهودا،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar then allowed him to depart, and he returned home.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم خلى سبيله وانصرف.

The History of al-Tabari: However, once Fayruz arrived back in his kingdom, overweening pride and uncontrollable rashness led him to renew the war with Akhshunwar.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما صار إلى مملكته حمله الأنف والحمية على معاودة اخشنوار،

The History of al-Tabari: He led an attack on Akhshunwar, despite the advice of his viziers and his close advisers against this, since it involved breaking the agreement; but he rejected their words and would only persist in following his own judgment.
تاريخ الطبري: فغزاه بعد أن نهاه وزراؤه وخاصته عن ذلك، لما فيه من نقض العهد، فلم يقبل منهم وأبى إلا ركوب رأيه،

The History of al-Tabari: Among those who counseled against this course of action was a man called Muzdbuwadh (?) who was especially close to Fayruz and whose opinion Fayruz used to seek out.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان فيمن نهاه عن ذلك رجل كان يخصه ويجتبي رأيه، يقال له مزدبوذ،

The History of al-Tabari: When Muzdbuwadh perceived Fayruz's firm determination, he set down what had passed between him and the king in a document, which he asked Fayruz to seal.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما رأى مزدبوذ لجاجته، كتب ما دار بينهما في صحيفة، وسأله الختم عليها،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz now set off on his expedition toward Akhshunwar's territory.
تاريخ الطبري: ومضى فيروز لوجهه نحو بلاد اخشنوار،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar had dug a great trench (khandaq) between his own and Fayruz's territory.
تاريخ الطبري: وقد كان اخشنوار حفر خندقا بينه وبين بلاد فيروز عظيما،

The History of al-Tabari: When Fayruz came to this, he threw bridges across it and set up on them banners which would be guiding markers for him and his troops on the way back home, and then crossed over to confront the enemy.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما انتهى إليه فيروز عقد عليه القناطر، ونصب عليها رايات جعلها أعلاما له ولأصحابه في انصرافهم، وجاز الى القوم،

The History of al-Tabari: When Akhshunwar came up to their encampment, he publicly adduced before Fayruz the document with the agreement he had written for Akhshunwar, and warned him about his oath and his undertaking; but Fayruz rejected this and only persisted in his contentiousness and squaring up to his opponent.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما التقى بعسكرهم احتج عليه اخشنوار بالكتاب الذي كتبه له، ووعظه بعهده وميثاقه، فأبى فيروز إلا لجاجا ومحكا وتواقفا،

The History of al-Tabari: Each one of them addressed his opponent in lengthy speeches, but in the end, they became enmeshed in the toils of war.
تاريخ الطبري: فكلم كل واحد منهما صاحبه كلاما طويلا، ونشبت بينهما بعد ذلك الحرب،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz's followers were, however, in a weakened and defeatist state because of the agreement that had existed between them and the Hephthalites.
تاريخ الطبري: وأصحاب فيروز على فتور من أمرهم، للعهد الذي كان بينهم وبين الهياطلة،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar brought forth the document Fayruz had written out for him and raised it up on the tip of a lance, calling out, "O God, act according to what is in  this document!" Fayruz was routed, mistook the place where the standards had been set up [as markers], fell into the trench, and perished.
تاريخ الطبري: وأخرج اخشنوار الصحيفة التي كتبها له فيروز، فرفعها على رمح وقال: اللهم خذ بما في هذا الكتاب فانهزم فيروز وسها عن موضع الرايات، وسقط في الخندق، فهلك،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar seized Fayruz's baggage, his womenfolk, his wealth, and his administrative bureaus (dawawlnuhu).
تاريخ الطبري: وأخذ اخشنوار أثقال فيروز ونساءه وأمواله ودواوينه،

The History of al-Tabari: The Persian army suffered a defeat the like of which they had never before experienced.
تاريخ الطبري: وأصاب جند فارس شيء لم يصبهم مثله قط

The History of al-Tabari: There was in Sijistan a man of the Persians, from the people of the district of Ardashir Khurrah, who had insight, strength in battle, and bravery, and who was called Sukhra.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان بسجستان رجل من أهل كورة اردشير خرة من الأعاجم، ذو علم وبأس وبطش، يقال له: سوخرا،

The History of al-Tabari: He had with him a detachment of cavalrymen.
تاريخ الطبري: ومعه جماعة من الاساورة،

The History of al-Tabari: When he received the news about Fayruz, he rode off that same night, traveling as far as he could, till he came up with Akhshunwar.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما بلغه خبر فيروز ركب من ليلته، فأغذ السير حتى انتهى إلى اخشنوار،

The History of al-Tabari: He sent a messenger, announcing to him his intention of making war and threatening him with destruction and ruin.
تاريخ الطبري: فأرسل إليه وآذنه بالحرب، وتوعده بالجائحة والبوار،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar dispatched a mighty army against Sukhra.
تاريخ الطبري: فبعث إليه اخشنوار جيشا عظيما

The History of al-Tabari: When the two sides met, Sukhra rode out against them, and found them eager for battle.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما التقوا ركب إليهم سوخرا فوجدهم مدلين،

The History of al-Tabari: It is said that he shot an arrow at a man who had ridden out to attack him,- the arrow struck the latter's horse between the eyes and became almost totally sunk in its head.
تاريخ الطبري: فيقال: إنه رمى بعض من ورد عليه منهم رمية فوقعت بين عيني فرسه حتى كادت النشابة تغيب في رأسه،

The History of al-Tabari: The horse fell down dead, and Sukhra was able to capture its rider.
تاريخ الطبري: فسقط الفرس وتمكن سوخرا من راكبه،

The History of al-Tabari: Sukhra spared his life, and instructed him to go back to his master and inform him about what he had seen.
تاريخ الطبري: فاستبقاه وقال له:
انصرف إلى صاحبك فأخبره بما رايت،

The History of al-Tabari: The (Hephthalite) troops went back to Akhshunwar bearing with them the horse's corpse.
تاريخ الطبري: فانصرفوا الى اخشنوار، وحملوا الفرس معهم،

The History of al-Tabari: When Akhshunwar saw the effects of the arrow shot, he was amazed, and sent a message to Sukhra, saying, "Ask whatever you want!" Sukhra told him, "I want you to return to me the government exchequer (al-dlwan) and to release the captives: The king did that.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما رأى أثر الرمية بهت وأرسل إلى سوخرا: أن سل حاجتك، فقال له: حاجتي أن ترد علي الديوان، وتطلق الأسرى ففعل ذلك،

The History of al-Tabari: When Sukhra had taken possession of the ex-117 chequer and had secured the release of the captives, he extracted from the exchequer records a certified statement of the monies that Fayruz had had with him, and then wrote to Akhshunwar that he was not going to leave without this money.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما صار الديوان في يده، واستنفذ الأسرى، استخرج من الديوان بيوت الأموال التي كانت مع فيروز، فكتب إلى اخشنوار إنه غير منصرف إلا بها

The History of al-Tabari: When Sukhra's determination became apparent to Akhshunwar, he purchased his freedom (i.e., from the threatenings of Sukhra, by handing over the missing money).
تاريخ الطبري: فلما تبين الجد، افتدى نفسه

The History of al-Tabari: Sukhra was able thus to return to the Persian land after rescuing the captives and after getting hold of the exchequer, with the money and all the contents of the treasuries that had been with Fayruz, now given back.
تاريخ الطبري: وانصرف سوخرا بعد استنقاذ الأسارى وأخذ الديوان وارتجاع الأموال، وجميع ما كان مع فيروز من خزائنه إلى أرض فارس،

The History of al-Tabari: When he arrived back to the Persians, they received him with great honor, extolled his feats, and raised him to a lofty status such as none but kings were able to attain after him.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما صار إلى الأعاجم شرفوه وعظموا أمره، وبلغوا به من المنزلة ما لم يكن بعده إلا الملك.

The History of al-Tabari: He was Sukhra, son of WIsabur, son of Z.han, son of  Narsi, son of WIsabur, son of Qarin, son of K.wan, son of ’b.y.d, son of ’w.b.y.d, son of TIruyah, son of K.r.d.n.k, son of Naw.r, son of Tus, son of Nawdhar, son of M.n.shu, son of Nawdar, son of Manushihr.
تاريخ الطبري: وهو سوخرا بن ويسابور بن زهان بن نرسي بن ويسابور بن قارن ابن كروان بن أبيد بن أوبيد بن تيرويه بن كردنك بن ناور بن طوس ابن نودكا بن منشو بن نودر بن منوشهر.

The History of al-Tabari: Another authority knowledgeable about the historical narratives of the Persians has mentioned the story of Fayruz and Akhshunwar in similar terms to what I have just recounted, except that he has stated that when Fayruz set out and headed toward Akhshunwar, he appointed as his deputy over the cities of Ctesiphon and Bahurasur—the two royal residences—this person Sukhra  He related: The latter was called, on account of his rank, Qarin, and used to be governor of Sijistan as well as of the two cities.
تاريخ الطبري: وذكر بعض أهل العلم بأخبار الفرس من خبر فيروز وخبر اخشنوار نحوا مما ذكرت، غير أنه ذكر أن فيروز لما خرج متوجها إلى اخشنوار، استخلف على مدينة طيسبون ومدينة بهرسير- وكانتا محلة الملوك- سوخرا هذا، قَالَ: وكان يقال لمرتبته قارن، وكان يلي معهما سجستان

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz came to a tower (manaiah) Bahrain Jur had constructed in the zone between the border of the land of Khurasan and the land of the Turks in order that the latter should not cross the frontier into Khurasan—all this in accordance with the covenant between the Turks and the Persians providing that each side should renounce transgressing the other's frontiers.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن فيروز لما بلغ منارة كان بهرام جور ابتناها فيما بين تخوم بلاد خراسان وبلاد الترك، لئلا يجوزها الترك إلى خراسان لميثاق كان بين الترك والفرس على ترك الفريقين التعدى لها،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz likewise had made an agreement with Akhshunwar not to pass beyond the tower into the land of the Hephthalites.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان فيروز عاهد اخشنوار الا يجاوزها الى بلاد الهياطلة،

The History of al-Tabari: [After reaching the tower,] Fayruz gave orders, and had fifty elephants plus three hundred men linked together, and had it (sc., the tower) dragged forward, while he came along behind it.
تاريخ الطبري: امر فيروز فصفد فيها خمسون فيلا وثلاثمائة رجل، فجرت أمامه جرا، واتبعها،

The History of al-Tabari: He intended by means of this to assert that he had ostensibly kept faith with Akhshunwar regarding his agreement with him.
تاريخ الطبري: أراد بذلك زعم الوفاء لاخشنوار بما عاهده عليه،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar got news of what Fayruz was up to in connection with that tower.
تاريخ الطبري: فبلغ اخشنوار ما كان من فيروز في أمر تلك المنارة،

The History of al-Tabari: He sent an envoy to Fayruz with the message, "Desist, O Fayruz, from what your forefathers abandoned, and don't embark on what they didn't attempt to do!"
تاريخ الطبري: فأرسل إليه يقول: انته يا فيروز عما انتهى عنه أسلافك، ولا تقدم على ما لم يقدموا عليه

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz took no notice of his words and Akhshunwar's message left him unmoved.
تاريخ الطبري: فلم يحفل فيروز بقوله، ولم تكرثه رسالته،

The History of al-Tabari: He began to try and tempt Akhshunwar into a direct military engagement and summoned him to this, but Akhshunwar kept on holding back and showing an aversion for this, because the Turks' method of warfare consists for the most part in trickery, deceitfulness, and stratagems.
تاريخ الطبري: وجعل يستطعم محاربة اخشنوار، ويدعوه إليها، وجعل اخشنوار يمتنع من محاربته ويستكرهها، لأن جل محاربة الترك إنما هو بالخداع والمكر والمكايدة،

The History of al-Tabari: Furthermore, Akhshunwar ordered a trench to be dug behind the lines of his own army, ten cubits wide and twenty cubits deep.
تاريخ الطبري: وإن اخشنوار أمر فحفر خلف عسكره خندق عرضه عشرة أذرع، وعمقه عشرون ذراعا،

The History of al-Tabari: He had light branches of wood laid over it and then had it covered with earth.
تاريخ الطبري: وغمى بخشب ضعاف، وألقى عليه ترابا،

The History of al-Tabari: Then he retired with his troops to a spot not too far away.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم ارتحل في جنده، فمضى غير بعيد،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz received news of Akhshunwar's departure from his encampment with his troops, and had no doubt that this meant Akhshunwar's withdrawal and flight.
تاريخ الطبري: فبلغ فيروز رحلة اخشنوار بجنده من عسكره، فلم يشك في أن ذلك منهم انكشاف وهرب،

The History of al-Tabari: He ordered the drums to be beaten, and rode out at the head of his troops in pursuit of Akhshunwar and his followers.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمر بضرب الطبول، وركب في جنده في طلب اخشنوار وأصحابه،

The History of al-Tabari: They rushed forward impetuously, heading directly toward that trench.
تاريخ الطبري: فأغذوا السير، وكان مسلكهم على ذلك الخندق

The History of al-Tabari: But when they reached it, they rushed blindly on to the trench's covering.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما بلغوه اقحموا على عماية،

The History of al-Tabari: Fayruz and the whole mass of his army fell into the pit and perished to the last man.
تاريخ الطبري: فتردى فيه فيروز وعامة جنده، وهلكوا من عند آخرهم.

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar wheeled round to Fayruz's encampment and took possession of everything there.
تاريخ الطبري: وإن اخشنوار عطف على عسكر فيروز، فاحتوى على كل شيء فيه،

The History of al-Tabari: He took captive the Chief Mobadh, and among Fayruz's womenfolk who fell into his hands was Fayruzdukht, his daughter.
تاريخ الطبري: وأسر موبذان موبذ، وصارت فيروز دخت ابنة فيروز فيمن صار في يده من نساء فيروز،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar gave orders for the corpses of Fayruz and all those who had fallen into that trench with him to be retrieved, and they were laid out on funerary structures {al-nawawis).
تاريخ الطبري: وامر اخشنوار فاستخرجت جثة فيروز وجثة كل من سقط معه في ذلك الخندق، فوضعت في النواويس،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar sent for Fayruzdukht, wishing to join with her in sexual congress, but she refused.
تاريخ الطبري: ودعا اخشنوار فيروز دخت إلى أن يباشرها، فأبت عليه.

The History of al-Tabari: When the news of Fayruz's death reached the Persian lands, the people were thrown into perturbation and terror.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن خبر هلاك فيروز سقط إلى بلاد فارس، فارتجوا له وفزعوا،

The History of al-Tabari: However, when Sukhra became convinced of the exact truth of Fayruz's fate, he got ready and advanced with the greater part of the troops at his disposal against the Hephthalite lands.
تاريخ الطبري: حتى إذا استقرت حقيقة خبره عند سوخرا تأهب وسار في عظم من كان قبله من الجند إلى بلاد الهياطلة

The History of al-Tabari: When Sukhra reached Jur- jan, Akhshunwar received news of his expedition to attack him, so he prepared for war and moved toward engaging Sukhra in battle,- and at the same time he sent to Sukhra asking him about his intentions and enquiring what his name and his official position were.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما بلغ جرجان بلغ اخشنوار خبر مسيره لمحاربته، فاستعد وأقبل متلقيا له، وأرسل إليه يستخبره عن خبره، ويسأله عن اسمه ومرتبته،

The History of al-Tabari: Sukhra sent back the message that he was a man with the personal name of Sukhra and the official rank of Qarin, and that his intention in marching against Akhshunwar was to take vengeance on him for Fayruz's death.
تاريخ الطبري: فأرسل أنه رجل يقال له سوخرا، ولمرتبته قارن، وأنه إنما سار إليه لينتقم منه لفيروز،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar returned a message to him: "Your way of proceeding in this affair you have undertaken is exactly like Fayruz's was, since despite the numerousness of his troops, the sole consequence of his attacking me was his own destruction and perdition."
تاريخ الطبري: فأرسل إليه اخشنوار يقول: إن سبيلك في الأمر الذي قدمت له كسبيل فيروز إذ لم يعقبه في كثرة جنوده من محاربته إياي إلا الهلكة والبوار.

The History of al-Tabari: But Akhshunwar's words did not deter Sukhra, and he paid no heed to them.
تاريخ الطبري: فلم ينهنه سوخرا قول اخشنوار، ولم يعبأ به،

The History of al-Tabari: He gave orders to his troops, and they got ready for battle and girded on their weapons.
تاريخ الطبري: وأمر جنوده فاستعدوا وتسلحوا،

The History of al-Tabari: He moved forward against Akhshunwar, advancing with firm determination and a keen mind (literally, "heart").
تاريخ الطبري: وزحف إلى اخشنوار لشدة إقدامه وحدة قلبه،

The History of al-Tabari: Akhshunwar sought a truce and a peace agreement with Sukhra, but the latter refused to contemplate any peace agreement with him unless he could recover everything Akhshunwar had appropriated from Fayruz's encampment.
تاريخ الطبري: فطلب موادعته وصلحه، فلم يقبل منه سوخرا صلحا دون أن يصير في يده كل شيء صار عنده من عسكر فيروز

The History of al-Tabari: So Akhshunwar returned to him everything he had seized from Fayruz's camp, including his treasuries, the contents of his stables, and his womenfolk, including Fayruzdukht, and he handed back to him the Chief Mobadh and every single one of the great men of the Persians in his possession.
تاريخ الطبري: فسلم اخشنوار إليه ما أصاب من أموال فيروز وخزائنه ومرابطه ونسائه، وفيهن فيروز دخت، ودفع إليه موبذان موبذ وكل أحد كان عنده من عظماء الفرس،

The History of al-Tabari: Sukhra then went back to the land of the Persians with all that.
تاريخ الطبري: فانصرف سوخرا بذلك كله إلى بلاد الفرس.

The History of al-Tabari: The authorities differ concerning [the length of] Fayruz's reign.
تاريخ الطبري: واختلف في مدة ملك فيروز،

The History of al-Tabari: Some say it was twenty-six years, others twenty-one years.
تاريخ الطبري: فقال بعضهم: كانت ستا وعشرين سنة. وقال آخرون: كانت إحدى وعشرين سنة

The History of al-Tabari: Mention of Events in the Reigns of Yazdajiid (II), Son of Bahrdm (V), and Fayruz and the Relations of Theii Respective Governors with the Arabs and the People of Yemen
تاريخ الطبري: ذكر ما كان من الأحداث في أيام يزدجرد بن بهرام وفيروز بين عمالهما على العرب واهل اليمن

The History of al-Tabari: Information was transmitted to me from Hisham b. Muham-mad, who said: The sons of the nobles of Himyar and others from the Arab tribes used to serve the kings of Himyar during theirperiod of royal power.
تاريخ الطبري: حدثت عن هشام بن مُحَمَّد، قَالَ: كان يخدم الملوك من حمير في زمان ملكهم أبناء الأشراف من حمير وغيرهم من القبائل،

The History of al-Tabari: Among those who served Hassan b. Tubba' was 'Amr b. Hujr al-Kindi, the chief of Kindah during his time.
تاريخ الطبري: فكان ممن يخدم حسان بن تبع عمرو بن حجر الكندي، وكان سيد كندة في زمانه

The History of al-Tabari: When Hassan b. Tubba' led an expedition against the Jadis, he appointed 'Amr as his deputy over certain affairs.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما سار حسان بن تبع إلى جديس خلفه على بعض أموره،

The History of al-Tabari: When 'Amr b. Tubba' killed his brother Hassan b. Tubba' and assumed the royal power in his stead, he took 'Amr b. Hujr al- Kindi into his personal service.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما قتل عمرو بن تبع أخاه حسان بن تبع، وملك مكانه، اصطنع عمرو بن حجر الكندي.

The History of al-Tabari: 'Amr b. Hujr was a man of sound judgment and sagacity.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان ذا رأي ونبل،

The History of al-Tabari: 'Amr b. Tubba' intended to honor him and at the same time to diminish the status of his brother Hassan's sons, and as part of this policy he gave Hassan b. Tubba''s daughter in marriage to 'Amr b. Hujr.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان مما أراد عمرو إكرامه به وتصغير بني أخيه حسان أن زوجه ابنة حسان بن تبع،

The History of al-Tabari: The Himyarites grumbled at this, and among them were some young men who were concerned about her, because none of the Arabs had previously been bold enough to desire a marriage alliance with that house (sc., the Himyarites).
تاريخ الطبري: فتكلمت في ذلك حمير وكان عندهم من الأحداث التي ابتلوا بها، لأنه لم يكن يطمع في التزويج إلى أهل ذلك البيت أحد من العرب

The History of al-Tabari: Hassan b. Tubba''s daughter bore al-Harith b. 'Amr to 'Amr b. Hujr.
تاريخ الطبري: وولدت ابنة حسان بن تبع لعمرو بن حجر الحارث بن عمرو،

The History of al-Tabari: After 'Amr b. Tubba', 'Abd Kulal b. Muthawwib succeeded to the royal power.
تاريخ الطبري: وملك بعد عمرو بن تبع عبد كلال بن مثوب،

The History of al-Tabari: This was because the sons of Hassan were only small, except for Tubba' b. Hassan, whom the jinn had rendered mentally unbalanced.
تاريخ الطبري: وذلك أن ولد حسان كانوا صغارا، إلا ما كان من تبع بن حسان، فإن الجن استهامته،

The History of al-Tabari: Hence Abu Kulal b. Muthawwib assumed the royal power [temporarily], fearing lest someone outside the royal house of the kingdom might covet it.
تاريخ الطبري: فأخذ الملك عبد كلال بن مثوب مخافة أن يطمع في الملك غير اهل بيت المملكة،

The History of al-Tabari: He was qualified to exercise this power through his mature years, his experience, and his excellent powers of governing. According to what has been mentioned, he was an adherent of the original form of Christianity ['ala din al-Nasraniyyah al-ula), but used to conceal this from his people.
تاريخ الطبري: فوليه بسن وتجربة وسياسة حسنة وكان- فيما ذكروا- على دين النصرانية الأولى، وكان يسر ذلك من قومه،

The History of al-Tabari: He had been converted to that faith by a man of Ghassan who had come from Syria, but whom the Himyarites had then attacked and killed.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان الذي دعاه إليه رجل من غسان، قدم عليه من الشام، فوثبت حمير بالغساني فقتلته،

The History of al-Tabari: At that point, Tubba' b. Hassan recovered his sanity and was restored to health.
تاريخ الطبري: فرجع تبع بن حسان من استهامة الجن إياه صحيحا،

The History of al-Tabari: He was highly knowledgeable about the stars, the most intelligent among those who had learned [the sciences] in his time, and the one with the most information and lore con-cerning both the past and what was to come after him in the future.
تاريخ الطبري: وهو أعلم الناس بنجم، وأعقل من تعلم في زمانه، وأكثره حديثا عما كان قبله وما يكون في الزمان بعده

The History of al-Tabari: Hence Tubba' b. Hassan b. Tubba' b. Malikay Karib b. Tubba' al-Aqran was raised to the kingship.
تاريخ الطبري: فملك تبع ابن حسان بن تبع بن ملكيكرب بن تبع الأقرن،

The History of al-Tabari: Himyar and the Arabs stood in intense awe of him.
تاريخ الطبري: فهابته حمير والعرب هيبة شديدة،

The History of al-Tabari: He then sent his sister's son al-Harith b. 'Amr b. Hujr al-Kindi at the head of a powerful army against the lands of Ma'add, al-Hirah , and the districts adjacent to them both.
تاريخ الطبري: فبعث بابن أخته الحارث بن عمرو بن حجر الكندي في جيش عظيم إلى بلاد معد والحيرة وما والاها

The History of al-Tabari: Al-Harith marched against al-Nu'man b. Imri’ al-Qays b. al- Shaqiqah and fought with him; al-Nu'man and a number of his family were killed, and his companions were routed.
تاريخ الطبري: فسار إلى النعمان بن امرئ القيس ابن الشقيقة فقاتله، فقتل النعمان وعدة من أهل بيته، وهزم أصحابه

The History of al-Tabari: Only al- Mundhir b. al-Nu'man al-Akbar, whose mother was Ma’ al-Sama’, a woman of the Banu al-Namir, managed to escape from al-Harith.
تاريخ الطبري: وأفلته المنذر بن النعمان الأكبر وأمه ماء السماء، امرأة من النمر،

The History of al-Tabari: In this way the royal power of the house of al-Nu’man passed away, and al-Harith b. 'Amr al-Kindi succeeded to their former power and possessions.
تاريخ الطبري: فذهب ملك آل النعمان، وملك الحارث بن عمرو الكندي ما كانوا يملكون.

The History of al-Tabari: Hisham related: After al-Nu'man, his son al-Mundhir b. al- Nu'man succeeded to the royal power, al-Mundhir's mother being Hind bt. Zayd Manat b. Zayd Allah b. 'Amr al-Ghassanl,32,0 for forty-four years, of which eight years and nine months fell within the time of Bahrain (V) Jur, son of Yazdajird (I); eighteen years fell within the time of Yazdajird (II), son of Bahram, and seventeen years within the time of Fayruz b. Yazdajird (n).
تاريخ الطبري: وقال هشام: ملك بعد النعمان ابنه المنذر بن النعمان وأمه هند ابنة زيد مناة بن زيد الله بن عمرو الغساني أربعا وأربعين سنة، من ذلك في زمن بهرام جور بن يزدجرد ثماني سنين وتسعة أشهر، وفي زمن يزدجرد بن بهرام ثماني عشرة سنة وفي زمن فيروز بن يزدجرد سبع عشرة سنة

The History of al-Tabari: After him there reigned his son al-Aswad b. al-Mundhir, whose mother was Hirr bt. al-Nu'man from the descendants of al-Hayjumanah bt. 'Amr b. Abi Rabi’ah b. Dhuhl b. Shayban
تاريخ الطبري: ثم ملك بعده ابنه الأسود بن المنذر، وأمه هر ابنة النعمان من بني الهيجمانة، ابنة عمرو بْن أبي ربيعة بْن ذهل بْن شيبان،

The History of al-Tabari: It was he whom the Persians imprisoned.
تاريخ الطبري: وهو الذي أسرته فارس

The History of al-Tabari: [He reigned for] twenty years, of which ten years fell within the time of Fayruz, son of Yazdajird (II), four years in the time of Balash, son of Yazdajird (II), and six years in the time of Qubadh, son of Fayruz.
تاريخ الطبري: عشرين سنة، من ذلك في زمن فيروز بن يزدجرد عشر سنين، وفي زمن بلاش بن يزدجرد أربع سنين، وفي زمن قباذ بن فيروز، ست سنين.

The History of al-Tabari: [Balash]
تاريخ الطبري: ذكر ملك بلاش بن فيروز

The History of al-Tabari: Then there succeeded to the royal power after Fayruz, son of Yazdajird (II), his son Balash.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم قام بالملك بعد فيروز بن يزدجرد ابنه بلاش

The History of al-Tabari: (He was) the son of Fayruz, son of Yazdajird (II), son of Bahram (V) Jur.
تاريخ الطبري: بن فيروز بن يزدجرد ابن بهرام جور،

The History of al-Tabari: His brother Qubadh had disputed the succession with him, but Balash had emerged victorious and Qubadh had fled to Khaqan, king of the Turks, seeking his help and military aid.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان قباذ أخوه قد نازعه الملك، فغلب بلاش، وهرب قباذ إلى خاقان ملك الترك يسأله المعونة والمدد،

The History of al-Tabari: When the crown was placed on Balash's head, the great men of state and the nobles gathered round him, hailed him with congratulations, and invoked divine blessings on him.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما عقد التاج لبلاش على رأسه اجتمع إليه العظماء والأشراف فهنئوه ودعوا له،

The History of al-Tabari: They requested him to reward Sukhra for what he had done, so Balash marked him out as one of his special favorites, honored him and gave him rich presents.
تاريخ الطبري: وسألوه أن يكافئ سوخرا بما كان منه، فخصه وأكرمه وحباه،

The History of al-Tabari: Balash invariably behaved in a praiseworthy manner and had an intense care for the prosperity of the land.
تاريخ الطبري: ولم يزل بلاش حسن السيرة، حريصا على العمارة

The History of al-Tabari: His laudable concern for this reached the extent that, whenever he heard of the ruin of a house and the flight of its inhabitants, he would punish the owner of the village because of his lack of lively concern for them and lack of relief for their need, so that they would not have been compelled to abandon their homes.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان بلغ من حسن نظره إنه كان لا يبلغه أن بيتا خرب وجلا أهله عنه إلا عاقب صاحب القرية التي فيها ذلك البيت على تركه انتعاشهم وسد فاقتهم حتى لا يضطروا إلى الجلاء عن أوطانهم،

The History of al-Tabari: He built in the Sawad a city he called Balashawadh, which is Sabat near al-Mada’in
تاريخ الطبري: وبنى بالسواد مدينه سماها بلا شاواذ، وهي مدينة ساباط التي بقرب المدائن.

The History of al-Tabari: His reign lasted four years.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان ملكه اربع سنين.

The History of al-Tabari: [Qubddh I]
تاريخ الطبري: ذكر ملك قباذ بن فيروز

The History of al-Tabari: Then there succeeded to the royal power Qubadh, son of Fayruz, son of Yazdajird (II), son of Bahrain (V) Jur.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم ملك قباذ بن فيروز بن يزدجرد بن بهرام جور،

The History of al-Tabari: Before Qubadh attained the throne, he had fled to Khaqan, seeking help from him against his brother Balash.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان قباذ قبل أن يصير الملك إليه قد سار إلى خاقان مستنصرا به على أخيه بلاش،

The History of al-Tabari: On his way there, he passed through the vicinity of Naysabur, accompanied by a small band of companions fleeing with him in disguise.
تاريخ الطبري: فمر في طريقه بحدود نيسابور، ومعه جماعة يسيرة ممن شايعه على الشخوص متنكرين،

The History of al-Tabari: Among these was Zarmihr, son of Sukhra.
تاريخ الطبري: وفيهم زرمهر بن سوخرا،

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh had an intense desire for sexual satisfaction, complained about this to Zarmihr, and asked the latter to seek out a wife of good family [dhat hasab) for him.
تاريخ الطبري: فتاقت نفس قباذ إلى الجماع، فشكا ذلك إلى زرمهر، وسأله أن يلتمس له امرأة ذات حسب،

The History of al-Tabari: Zarmihr did that, and went along to the wife of his major-domo (sahib manzilihi), who was one of his cavalrymen; she had a virgin daughter, of outstanding beauty.
تاريخ الطبري: ففعل ذلك، وصار إلى امرأة صاحب منزله، وكان رجلا من الأساورة، وكانت له ابنة بكر فائقة في الجمال،

The History of al-Tabari: He asked her, as a sincere friend, for her daughter, and indicated to her that he would send her along to Qubadh.
تاريخ الطبري: فتنصح لها في ابنتها، وأشار عليها أن تبعث بها إلى قباذ،

The History of al-Tabari: The wife told her husband about that, while Zarmihr kept on setting forth to the two of them how attractive a proposition it was and spelling out to them how alluring a prospect it was for them, until finally they consented.
تاريخ الطبري: فأعلمت ذلك زوجها، ولم يزل زرمهر يرغب المرأة وزوجها، ويشير عليهما بما يرغبهما فيه حتى فعلا

The History of al-Tabari: The girl, who was called Niwandukht, came to Qubadh; he lay with her that very night, and she became pregnant with Anusharwan.
تاريخ الطبري: ، وصارت الابنة إلى قباذ، واسمها نيوندخت، فغشيها قباذ في تلك الليلة، فحملت بانوشروان،

The History of al-Tabari: He ordered for her a handsome present and gave her a noble reward.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمر لها بجائزة حسنة، وحباها حباء جزيلا.

The History of al-Tabari: It has been said that the mother of that girl asked her about Qubadh's appearance and bodily form: The girl told her that she knew nothing about that except that she noticed that his trousers were embroidered with gold.
تاريخ الطبري: وقيل إن أم تلك الجارية سألتها عن هيئة قباذ وحاله فأعلمتها أنها لا تعرف من ذلك غير أنها رأت سراويله منسوجا بالذهب،

The History of al-Tabari: Her mother knew thereby that he was a royal prince, and this gave her happiness.
تاريخ الطبري: فعلمت أمها أنه من أبناء الملوك وسرها ذلك

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh traveled on to Khaqan, and when he reached him, he told him that he was the son of the king of Persia and that his brother had contested the throne with him and had gained the upper hand.
تاريخ الطبري: ومضى قباذ إلى خاقان، فلما وصل إليه أعلمه أنه ابن ملك فارس، وأن أخاه ضاده في الملك وغلبه،

The History of al-Tabari: Hence he was now coming to Khaqan seeking help.
تاريخ الطبري: وأنه أتاه يستنصره

The History of al-Tabari: The latter gave him fine promises, but Qubadh remained at Khaqan's court for four years, during which Khaqan kept putting off his promise to Qubadh.
تاريخ الطبري: فوعده أحسن العدة، ومكث قباذ عند خاقان أربع سنين يدافعه بما وعده

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh became tired of waiting and sent a message to Khaqan's wife requesting her to adopt him as her own child, and requesting her to speak with her husband regarding him and ask him to fulfill his promise.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما طال الأمر على قباذ أرسل إلى امرأة خاقان يسألها أن تتخذه ولدا، وأن تكلم فيه زوجها، وتسأله إنجاز عدته

The History of al-Tabari: She did this, and kept on at length pressing Khaqan until he dispatched an army with Qubadh.
تاريخ الطبري: ففعلت، ولم تزل تحمل على خاقان حتى وجه مع قباذ جيشا،

The History of al-Tabari: When Qubadh departed with the military force and reached the vicinity of Naysabur, he asked the man who had brought the girl to him about what had happened to her.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما انصرف قباذ بذلك الجيش، وصار في ناحية نيسابور سأل الرجل الذي كان أتاه بالجارية عن أمرها

The History of al-Tabari: The man made enquiries of the girl's mother, who told him that she had given birth to a boy.
تاريخ الطبري: فاستخبر ذلك من أمها، فأخبرته أنها قد ولدت غلاما،

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh gave orders for the child to be brought to him.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمر قباذ أن يؤتى بها،

The History of al-Tabari: She came to him, bringing Anusharwan by her hand.
تاريخ الطبري: فأتته ومعها انو شروان تقوده بيدها

The History of al-Tabari: When she entered his presence, he asked her about the boy's history, and she informed him that he was his own son, that the boy resembled him in his bodily form and handsomeness.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما دخلت عليه سألها عن قصة الغلام، فأخبرته أنه ابنه، وإذا هو قد نزع إليه في صورته وجماله.

The History of al-Tabari: It is said that the news of Balash's death reached him on that very spot.
تاريخ الطبري: ويقال: إن الخبر ورد عليه في ذلك الموضع بهلاك بلاش

The History of al-Tabari: He regarded the child's birth as a good augury, and ordered him and his mother to be conveyed in wagons of the type customary for royal womenfolk.
تاريخ الطبري: فتيمن بالمولود، وأمر بحمله وحمل أمه على مراكب نساء الملوك،

The History of al-Tabari: When Qubadh reached al-Mada’in and had gathered together firmly in his hands all the reins of royal power, he sought out Sukhra for special honor, delegated to him all his executive powers, and gave him thanks for the service rendered to him by his son (sc., by Zarmihr).
تاريخ الطبري: فلما صار إلى المدائن، واستوثق له أمر الملك خص سوخرا، وفوض إليه أمره، وشكر له ما كان من خدمة ابنه إياه،

The History of al-Tabari: He then sent out troops to the distant frontiers, which inflicted hurt on his enemies and brought back numerous captive women and children.
تاريخ الطبري: ووجه الجنود إلى الأطراف، ففتكوا في الأعداء، وسبوا سبايا كثيرة،

The History of al-Tabari: Between al-Ahwaz and Fars he built the town of Arrajan, and likewise he built the town of Hulwan, and, in the administrative district (kurah) of Ardashir Khurrah, in the neighborhood of Karazin, a town called Qubadh Khurrah.
تاريخ الطبري: وبني بين الأهواز وفارس مدينة الرجان، وبنى أيضا مدينة حلوان، وبنى بكورة اردشير خرة في ناحيه كارزين مدينة يقال لها قباذ خرة،

The History of al-Tabari: All this was in addition to [other] towns and villages he founded and to [other] canals he had dug and bridges he had constructed.
تاريخ الطبري: وذلك سوى مدائن وقرى أنشأها، وسوى أنهار احتفرها، وجسور عقدها.

The History of al-Tabari: Now when the greater part of Qubadh's days had gone by, with Sukhra in charge of the government of the kingdom and the man-agement of affairs, the people came to Sukhra and undertook all their dealings with him, treating Qubadh as a person of no importance and regarding his commands with contempt.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما مضت أكثر أيامه، وتولى سوخرا تدبير ملكه وسياسة أموره مال الناس عليه، وعاملوه واستخفوا بقباذ، وتهاونوا بأمره،

The History of al-Tabari: At last, Qubadh became desirous of resuming power and was no longer able to endure that state of affairs or remain content with it.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما احتنك لم يحتمل ذلك، ولم يرض به،

The History of al-Tabari: He wrote to Sabur of al-Rayy, [a man] from the house called Mihran, who was Supreme Commander of the Land (i§bahbadh al- bilad) to come to him with the troops under his command.
تاريخ الطبري: وكتب إلى سابور الرازي- الذي يقال للبيت الذي هو منه مهران، وكان إصبهبذ البلاد- في القدوم عليه فيمن قبله من الجند،

The History of al-Tabari: Sabur came to him with these, and Qubadh sketched out for him the position regarding Sukhra and gave him the necessary orders concerning this last.
تاريخ الطبري: فقدم سابور بهم عليه، فواصفه قباذ حالة سوخرا، وأمره بأمره فيه،

The History of al-Tabari: The next morning, Sabur went into Qubadh's presence and found Sukhra seated there with the king.
تاريخ الطبري: فغدا سابور على قباذ فوجد عنده سوخرا جالسا،

The History of al-Tabari: He walked toward Qubadh, passing before Sukhra and paying no attention to him.
تاريخ الطبري: فمشى نحو قباذ متجاوزا له متغافلا لسوخرا،

The History of al-Tabari: Sukhra [for his part] gave no heed to this part of Sabur'scunning plan, until Sabur threw round his neck a noose he had with him and then dragged him off.
تاريخ الطبري: فلم يأبه سوخرا لذلك من أرب سابور، حتى ألقى وهقا كان معه في عنقه، ثم اجتذبه

The History of al-Tabari: He was taken away, loaded with fetters, and consigned to gaol.
تاريخ الطبري: فأخرجه فأوثقه واستودعه السجن،

The History of al-Tabari: People commented at that time, "Sukhra's wind has died away, and a wind belonging to Mihran has now started to blow," and this became proverbial.
تاريخ الطبري: فحينئذ قيل: نقصت ريح سوخرا وهبت لمهران ريح، وذهب ذلك مثلا

The History of al-Tabari: After that, Qubadh ordered Sukhra to be executed, and this was done.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن قباذ أمر بعد ذلك بقتل سوخرا فقتل،

The History of al-Tabari: When ten years had elapsed of Qubadh's reign, the Chief Mobadh and the great men of state agreed together on deposing Qubadh from his throne, so they did this and imprisoned him.
تاريخ الطبري: وأنه لما مضى لملك قباذ عشر سنين اجتمعت كلمة موبذان موبذ والعظماء على إزالته عن ملكه، فأزالوه عنه وحبسوه،

The History of al-Tabari: This was because he had become a follower of a man named Mazdak and his partisans, who proclaimed, "God has established  daily sustenance in the earth for His servants to divide out among themselves with equal shares, but men have oppressed each other regarding it."
تاريخ الطبري: لمتابعته لرجل يقال له مزدك مع أصحاب له قَالُوا: إن الله إنما جعل الأرزاق في الأرض ليقسمها العباد بينهم بالتآسي، ولكن الناس تظالموا فيها،

The History of al-Tabari: They further asserted that they were going to take from the rich for the poor and give to those possessing little out of the share of those possessing much; moreover, [they asserted that] those who had an excessive amount of wealth, womenfolk, and goods had no more right to them than anyone else.
تاريخ الطبري: وزعموا أنهم يأخذون للفقراء من الأغنياء، ويردون من المكثرين على المقلين، وانه من كان عنده فضل من الأموال والنساء والأمتعة فليس هو بأولى به من غيره،

The History of al-Tabari: The lower ranks of society took advantage of this and seized the opportunity; they rallied to Mazdak and his partisans and banded together with them.
تاريخ الطبري: فافترص السفلة ذلك واغتنموه، وكانفوا مزدك وأصحابه وشايعوهم،

The History of al-Tabari: The people (al-nas, i.e., the higher levels of society) suffered from the activities of the Mazdakites, and these last grew strong until they would burst in on a man in his own house and appropriate his dwelling, his womenfolk, and his possessions without the owner being able to stop them.
تاريخ الطبري: فابتلى الناس بهم، وقوي أمرهم حتى كانوا يدخلون على الرجل في داره فيغلبونه على منزله ونسائه وأمواله لا يستطيع الامتناع منهم،

The History of al-Tabari: They contrived to make all these doctrines attractive to Qubadh, but also threatened him with deposition (if he did not cooperate with them).
تاريخ الطبري: وحملوا قباذ على تزيين ذلك وتوعدوه بخلعه،

The History of al-Tabari: Very soon it came to pass that a man among them (i.e., the Mazdakites?) no longer knew his own son, nor a child his father, nor did a man any longer possess anything with which he could enjoy ampleness of life.
تاريخ الطبري: فلم يلبثوا إلا قليلا حتى صاروا لا يعرف الرجل منهم ولده، ولا المولود أباه، ولا يملك الرجل شيئا مما يتسع به

The History of al-Tabari: They now consigned Qubadh to a place to which only they had access and set up in his place a brother of his called Jamasb  They told Qubadh, "You have incurred sin by what you have done in the past, and the only thing that can purify you from it is handing over your womenfolk."
تاريخ الطبري: وصيروا قباذ في مكان لا يصل إليه أحد سواهم، وجعلوا أخا له يقال له جاماسب مكانه، وقالوا لقباذ: إنك قد أثمت فيما عملت به فيما مضى، وليس يطهرك من ذلك إلا إباحة نسائك،

The History of al-Tabari: They even wanted him to make  over himself to them as a sacrifice, so that they could kill him and make him an offering to the fire.
تاريخ الطبري: وأرادوه على أن يدفع إليهم نفسه فيذبحوه ويجعلوه قربانا للنار،

The History of al-Tabari: When Zarmihr, son of Sukhra, perceived this, he went forth with an accompanying group of the nobles, ready to expend his own life, and then killed a great number of the Mazdakites, restored Qubadh to his royal power and drove out his brother Jamasb.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما رأى ذلك زرمهر بن سوخرا خرج بمن شايعه من الأشراف باذلا نفسه، فقتل من المزدكية ناسا كثيرا، وأعاد قباذ إلى ملكه، وطرح أخاه جاماسب

The History of al-Tabari: After this, however, the Mazdakites kept on inciting Qubadh against Zarmihr to the point that Qubadh killed him.*
تاريخ الطبري: ثم لم يزل المزدكية بعد ذلك إنما يحرشون قباذ على زرمهر حتى قتله،

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh was always one of the best of the Persian kings until Mazdak seduced him into reprehensible ways.
تاريخ الطبري: ولم يزل قباذ من خيار ملوكهم حتى حمله مزدك على ما حمله عليه،

The History of al-Tabari: As a result, the bonds linking the outlying parts of the realm became loosened and the defense of the frontiers fell into neglect.
تاريخ الطبري: فانتشرت الأطراف وفسدت الثغور.

The History of al-Tabari: A certain person knowledgeable about the history of the Persians has [on the other hand] mentioned that it was the great men of state of the Persians who imprisoned Qubadh when he became a partisan of Mazdak and one of the followers of his doctrines, and who raised to the royal power in his stead his brother Jamasb, son of Fayruz.
تاريخ الطبري: وذكر بعض أهل العلم بأخبار الفرس أن العظماء من الفرس هم حبسوا قباذ حين اتبع مزدك وشايعه على ما دعاه إليه من أمره، وملكوا مكانه أخاه جاماسب بن فيروز

The History of al-Tabari: Now a sister of Qubadh's went to the prison where he was incarcerated and tried to gain entry, but the offical responsible for guarding the prison and its inmates prevented her from entering.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن أختا لقباذ أتت الحبس الذي كان فيه قباذ محبوسا، فحاولت الدخول عليه، فمنعها إياه الرجل الموكل كان بالحبس ومن فيه،

The History of al-Tabari: This man became roused by the desire to ravish her at that opportunity, and told her how much he desired her,- she informed him that she would not resist him in anything he might desire of her, so he let her in.
تاريخ الطبري: وطمع الرجل أن يفضحها بذلك السبب، وألقى إليها طمعه فيها، واخبرته أنها غير مخالفته في شيء مما يهوى منها، فأذن لها

The History of al-Tabari: She entered the prison, and spent a day with Qubadh.
تاريخ الطبري: فدخلت السجن فأقامت عند قباذ يوما

The History of al-Tabari: Then at her bidding, Qubadh was rolled up in one of the carpets in the gaol, and this was borne by one of his male attendants, a strong and hardy youth, and brought out of the prison.
تاريخ الطبري: وأمرت فلف قباذ في بساط من البسط التي كانت معه في الحبس، وحمل على غلام من غلمانه قوي ضابط، وأخرج من الحبس

The History of al-Tabari: When the lad went past the prison commander, the latter asked him what he was carrying. He was unable to answer, but Qubadh's sister came up behind the lad and told the prison commander that it was a bed roll she had slept on during her menstrual periods and that she was only going forth to purify herself and would then return.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما مر الغلام بوالي الحبس سأله عما كان حامله فأفحم، واتبعته أخت قباذ فأخبرته أنه فراش كانت افترشته في عراكها، وأنها إنما خرجت لتتطهر وتنصرف،

The History of al-Tabari: The man believed her, and did not touch the carpet or go near it, fearing lest he become polluted by it, and he allowed the lad who was bearing Qubadh to pass freely out.
تاريخ الطبري: فصدقها الرجل ولم يمس البساط، ولم يدن منه استقذارا له، وخلى عن الغلام الحامل لقباذ،

The History of al-Tabari: So he went along with Qubadh, the sister following after him.
تاريخ الطبري: فمضى بقباذ ومضت على أثره.

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh now took to flight until he reached the land of the Hepththalites, in order to ask their king to help him and to provide him with an army, so that he might make war on those who had rebelled against him and deposed him.
تاريخ الطبري: وهرب قباذ فلحق بأرض الهياطلة ليستمد ملكها ويستجيشه فيحارب من خالفه وخلعه

The History of al-Tabari: It has been further related that, on his outward journey to the Hepththalites, he halted at Abarshahr at the house of one of its leading citizens, who had a daughter of marriageable age, and it was on the occasion of this journey that he had sexual relations with the mother of Kisra Anusharwan
تاريخ الطبري: وأنه نزل في مبدئه إليها بابرشهر رجل من عظماء أهلها، له ابنة معصر، وأن نكاحه أم كسرى أنوشروان كان في سفره هذا،

The History of al-Tabari: It has been also related that Qubadh returned from that journey with his son Anusharwan and the latter's mother.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن قباذ رجع من سفره ذلك معه ابنه أنوشروان وأمه،

The History of al-Tabari: He defeated his brother Jamasb in the contest for royal power after the latter had reigned for six years
تاريخ الطبري: فغلب أخاه جاماسب على ملكه بعد أن ملك أخوه جاماسب ست سنين،

The History of al-Tabari: Then after that,Qubadh led an expedition against the land of the Romans, conquered one of their towns in al-Jazirah called Amid and carried off the women and children as captives.
تاريخ الطبري: وأن- قباذ غزا بعد ذلك بلاد الروم، وافتتح منها مدينة من مدن الجزيرة تدعى آمد، وسبى أهلها،

The History of al-Tabari: He gave orders for a town to be built in the borderland between Fars and the land of al- Ahwaz and named it Warn Qubadh; this is the town named Buqubadh,352  also called Arrajan.
تاريخ الطبري: وأمر فبنيت في حد ما بين فارس وأرض الأهواز مدينه، وسماها رامقباذ، وهي التي تسمى بومقباذ، وتدعى أيضا أرجان

The History of al-Tabari: He laid out an administrative division (kurah) and added to it rural districts (rasatiq) from the kurah of Surraq and that of Ram Hurmuz
تاريخ الطبري: وكور كورة، وجعل لها رساتيق من كوره سرق، كوره رام هرمز،

The History of al-Tabari: He then nominated his son Kisra as his successor in the royal power, and wrote this out in a document, which he sealed with his seal ring.
تاريخ الطبري: وملك قباذ ابنه كسرى، وكتب له بذلك كتابا وختمه بخاتمه.

The History of al-Tabari: When Qubadh died after having reigned for forty-three years, including the years of his brother Jamasb, Kisra put into execution the measures which Qubadh had commended to him.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما هلك قباذ- وكان ملكه بسني ملك أخيه جاماسب: ثلاثا وأربعين سنة- فنفذ كسرى ما أمر به قباذ

The History of al-Tabari: Mention of What Has Been Recorded Concerning the Events Taking Place among the Arabs in Qubadh’s Reign in His Kingdom and Involving His Governors
تاريخ الطبري: من ذلك ذكر ما كان من الحوادث التي كانت بين العرب في ايام قباذ في مملكته وبين عماله

The History of al-Tabari: There was related to me a narrative going back to Hisham b. Muhammad, who said: Al-Harith b. 'Amr b. Hujr b. 'Adi al-Kindl met al-Nu'man b. al-Mundhir b. Imri’ al-Qays b. al-Shaqlqah in battle and killed him, with al-Mundhir b. al-Nu'man al-Akbar escaping from al-Harith.
تاريخ الطبري: وحدثت عن هشام بن مُحَمَّد، قَالَ: لما لقي الحارث بن عمرو بن حجر ابن عدي الكندي النعمان بن المنذر بن امرئ القيس بن الشقيقه قتله، وأفلته المنذر بن النعمان الأكبر،

The History of al-Tabari: Al-Harith b. 'Amr al-Kindi then assumed power over the lands al-Nu'man had ruled.
تاريخ الطبري: وملك الحارث بن عمرو الكندي ما كان يملك،

The History of al-Tabari: At this point, Qubadh, son of Fayruz, the ruler of Persia, sent a message to al-Harith b. 'Amr, informing him that there had been formerly an agreement between him and his predecessor as king [among the Arabs] and that he would welcome a meeting with al-Harith.
تاريخ الطبري: بعث قباذ بن فيروز ملك فارس إلى الحارث بن عمرو الكندي: أنه قد كان بيننا وبين الملك الذي قد كان قبلك عهد، وإني أحب أن ألقاك.

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh was a Zindiq who did only good deeds, who abhorred shedding blood and who, in his dislike for shedding blood, treated his enemies with leniency.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان قباذ زنديقا يظهر الخير ويكره الدماء، ويداري أعداءه فيما يكره من سفك الدماء،

The History of al-Tabari: In his time, heretical opinions [al- ahwa’) became rife, and the people came to regard Qubadh as a weak ruler.
تاريخ الطبري: وكثرت الأهواء في زمانه، واستضعفه الناس،

The History of al-Tabari: Al-Harith b. 'Amr al-Kindl, however, set out with a numerous and well-equipped army, until the two forces met at the bridge of al-Fayyum.
تاريخ الطبري: فخرج إليه الحارث بن عمرو الكندي في عدد وعدة حتى التقوا بقنطرة الفيوم،

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh ordered a dish of dates and extracted their stones.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمر قباذ بطبق من تمر فنزع نواه،

The History of al-Tabari: Then he ordered another dish and placed in it dates in which the stones had been left.
تاريخ الطبري: وأمر بطبق فجعل فيه تمر فيه نواه،

The History of al-Tabari: These two dishes were placed before them (sc., Qubadh and al-Harith).
تاريخ الطبري: ثم وضعا بين أيديهما،

The History of al-Tabari: The dish of dates  with stones by al-Harith b. 'Amr, and the one with no date stones in it was placed by Qubadh.
تاريخ الطبري: فجعل الذي فيه النوى يلي الحارث بن عمرو، والذي لا نوى فيه يلي قباذ

The History of al-Tabari: Al-Harith began to eat the dates and to spit out the stones.
تاريخ الطبري: فجعل الحارث يأكل التمر ويلقي النوى،

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh set about eating [everything in] the dish in front of him, and said to al-Harith, "What's the matter with you? Why aren't you eating exactly what I'm eating?"
تاريخ الطبري: وجعل قباذ يأكل ما يليه، وقال للحارث: ما لك لا تاكل مثل ما آكل!

The History of al-Tabari: Al- Harith replied, "Among us, only camels and sheep eat date stones," and he realized that Qubadh was deriding him.
تاريخ الطبري: فقال: له الحارث إنما يأكل النوى إبلنا وغنمنا وعلم أن قباذ يهزأ به،

The History of al-Tabari: After this, the two of them made peace on the basis that al-Harith b. 'Amr and those he wished of his followers should bring their horses to drink from the Tigris up to their saddle girths but not pass any further beyond that point.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم اصطلحا على أن يورد الحارث بن عمرو ومن أحب من أصحابه خيولهم الفرات إلى ألبابها، ولا يجاوزوا أكثر من ذلك

The History of al-Tabari: But when al-Harith saw Qubadh's weakness, he began to covet the Sawad, and ordered the men in his garrison posts (masalihihi) to cross the Euphrates and carry out raids into the Sawad.
تاريخ الطبري: فلما رأى الحارث ما عليه قباذ من الضعف طمع في السواد، فأمر أصحاب مسالحه أن يقطعوا الفرات فيغيروا في السواد،

The History of al-Tabari: The cries for help [of the local people] reached Qubadh when he was at al-Mada’in, and he exclaimed: "This has occurred under the protection of their king," and he then sent a message to al-Harith b. 'Amr that some robbers of the Arabs had mounted raids and that he wanted a meeting with him.
تاريخ الطبري: فأتى قباذ الصريخ وهو بالمدائن فقال: هذا من تحت كنف ملكهم ثم أرسل إلى الحارث بن عمرو أن لصوصا من لصوص العرب قد أغاروا، وأنه يحب لقاءه

The History of al-Tabari: When al-Harith came, Qubadh said to him, "You have done something which no one before you has ever done," but al-Harith replied, "I haven't done anything, and don't know anything about it; it was some Arab robbers, and I myself cannot keep a firm hand over the Arabs except by financial subsidies and regular troops."
تاريخ الطبري: فلقيه، فقال له قباذ: لقد صنعت صنيعا ما صنعه أحد قبلك، فقال له الحارث: ما فعلت ولا شعرت، ولكنها لصوص من لصوص العرب، ولا أستطيع ضبط العرب إلا بالمال والجنود،

The History of al-Tabari: Qubadh said to him, "What do you want, then?"
تاريخ الطبري: قَالَ له قباذ:
فما الذي تريد؟

The History of al-Tabari: and he replied, "I want you to make over to me a grant of part of the Sawad so that I can get weapons ready by means of it."
تاريخ الطبري: قَالَ: أريد أن تطعمني من السواد ما اتخذ به سلاحا،

The History of al-Tabari: So Qubadh made over to him the side of the lower Euphrates bordering on the Arabs, comprising six tassujs.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمر له بما يلي جانب العرب من أسفل الفرات، وهي ستة طساسيج،

The History of al-Tabari: Al-Harith b. 'Amr al-Kindl at that point sent a messenger to Tubba' in Yemen, saying, "I covet strongly the kingdom of the Persians, and have already acquired six tassujs of it.
تاريخ الطبري: فأرسل الحارث بن عمرو الكندي إلى تبع وهو باليمن: انى قد طمعت في ملك الأعاجم، وقد أخذت منه ستة طساسيج،

The History of al-Tabari: So gather your troops together and advance, for there is nothing between you and their kingdom, since the king does not eat meat and does not consider the shedding of blood lawful, for he is a Zindiq."
تاريخ الطبري: فاجمع الجنود وأقبل فإنه ليس دون ملكهم شيء لان الملك عليهم لا يأكل اللحم، ولا يستحل هراقة الدماء لأنه زنديق

The History of al-Tabari: So Tubba' assembled his troops and advanced until he encamped at al-Hirah.
تاريخ الطبري: فجمع تبع الجنود، وسار حتى نزل الحيرة

The History of al-Tabari: He drew near to the Euphrates, where the midges plagued him.
تاريخ الطبري: وقرب من الفرات، فآذاه البق،

The History of al-Tabari: Al-Harith b. 'Amr ordered a canal to be dug for him as far as al-Najaf, and this was done: this is the Canal of al-Hirah.
تاريخ الطبري: فأمر الحارث بن عمرو أن يشق له نهرا إلى النجف ففعل، وهو نهر الحيرة

The History of al-Tabari: He encamped against there and sent his nephew Shamir Dhu al-Janah ("Shamir of the Wing") against Qubadh
تاريخ الطبري: فنزل عليه ووجه ابن أخيه شمرا ذا الجناح إلى قباذ،

The History of al-Tabari: He fought with Qubadh and routed him, compelling him to flee as far as al-Rayy.
تاريخ الطبري: فقاتله فهزمه شمر حتى لحق بالري،

The History of al-Tabari: He then caught up with Qubadh there and killed him.
تاريخ الطبري: ثم أدركه بها فقتله،

The History of al-Tabari: Tubba' now sent Shamir Dhu al-fanah to Khurasan and his son Hassan to Sogdia (al-Sughd), telling them, "Whichever of you reaches China first shall become ruler over it."
تاريخ الطبري: وأمضى تبع شمرا ذا الجناح إلى خراسان، ووجه تبع ابنه حسان إلى الصغد، وقال:
أيكما سبق إلى الصين فهو عليها

The History of al-Tabari: Each one headed a mighty army, said to be of 640,000 men.
تاريخ الطبري: وكان كل واحد منهما في جيش عظيم، يقال: كانا في ستمائه الف واربعين ألفا

The History of al-Tabari: He further sent his nephew Ya'fur against the Romans; it was he who recited:
تاريخ الطبري: وبعث ابن أخيه يعفر الى الروم، وهو الذى يقول:

The History of al-Tabari: O my companion, you may well be full of wonder at Himyar, when they encamped at al-Jabiyah! Eighty thousand is the number of their chiefs, and for each group of eight men there is a chief!
تاريخ الطبري: أيا صاح عجبك للداهية ... لحمير إذ نزلوا الجابية!
ثمانون ألفا رواياهمو ... لكل ثمانية راويه

The History of al-Tabari: Ya'fur proceeded until he reached Constantinople (al- Qustantiniyyah), whose people then gave him their obedience and promised to pay tribute, and then went on to Rome (Rumiyyah), a journey of four months, and besieged it.
تاريخ الطبري: فسار يعفر حتى أتى القسطنطينية، فأعطوه الطاعة والإتاوة، ثم مضى إلى رومية وبينهما مسيرة أربعة أشهر، فحاصرها

The History of al-Tabari: The troops accompanying him suffered great hunger, were afflicted by plague, and became weakened.
تاريخ الطبري: وأصاب من معه جوع، ووقع فيهم طاعون فرقوا،

The History of al-Tabari: The Romans perceived what had hit them, so fell upon them and killed them, with not a single man escaping.
تاريخ الطبري: فأبصرهم الروم وما لقوا، فوثبوا عليهم فقتلوهم، فلم يفلت منهم أحد

The History of al-Tabari: Shamir Dhu al-Janah traveled on until he reached Samarqand.
تاريخ الطبري: وسار شمر ذو الجناح حتى أتى سمرقند،
